description: News-to-blog test set. Each case is a news URL plus 2-3 hand-verified key facts from that article (checked 2026-10-25). The judge fails a post that contradicts a key fact. Case 14 is a negative case: the link is dead and the system must fail cleanly.

cases.event: US government takes ~10% stake in Intel
key_facts: The government receives 433.3 million shares of Intel common stock at $20.47 each.
The deal includes a warrant to buy another 5% of Intel's shares within five years.
The Biden administration had provided Intel with $7.86 billion in federal grants.

cases.event: 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics to Clarke, Devoret and Martinis
key_facts: The prize was awarded for the discovery of macroscopic quantum mechanical tunnelling and energy quantization in an electric circuit.
The award is SEK 11m (about $1.2m), shared equally by the three winners.
The prize is presented at a ceremony in Stockholm on 10 December.

cases.event: Final approval of Anthropic's $1.5 billion copyright settlement with authors
key_facts: The settlement is $1.5 billion.
U.S. District Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín ruled the settlement fair, reasonable and adequate.
Attorney fees were about $101.56 million, roughly 7% of the fund.

cases.event: Nvidia becomes first company worth $5 trillion
key_facts: Nvidia needed a share price of $205.76 for a $5 trillion market value.
Microsoft and Apple were each valued at about $4 trillion.
Nvidia stock had risen more than 50% year to date.

cases.event: Judge rules Google does not have to sell Chrome
key_facts: Judge Amit Mehta rejected the government's demand that Google sell Chrome.
In August 2024 Mehta had found Google unlawfully protected its search dominance.
Alphabet shares rose about 7.5 percent in after-hours trading.
Thieves stole eight items from two display cases.
The raid lasted less than eight minutes in total.
It happened about 250 metres from the Mona Lisa, around 30 minutes after opening.

cases.event: Cloudflare global outage caused by bot management feature file
key_facts: The global outage happened on November 18, 2025.
It began at 11:20 UTC.
The proxy hit a hardcoded limit of 200 features when the feature file grew too large.
Problems started at 11:49 PM PDT on October 19 in US-EAST-1.
DynamoDB was restored at 2:24 AM PDT on October 20.
Normal operations were fully restored by 3:01 PM PDT.

cases.event: Axiom-4 launches with India's Shubhanshu Shukla
key_facts: The mission lifted off from Launch Complex 39A at 2:31 am ET on June 25.
The launch was originally scheduled for June 11 and postponed after a liquid oxygen leak.
ISRO reportedly paid Rs 500 crore for the seat and training.

cases.event: Meta invests $14.3bn in Scale AI and hires CEO Alexandr Wang
key_facts: Meta is investing $14.3bn in Scale.
The deal values Scale at over $29 billion.
Scale generated $870m in revenue the previous year.

cases.event: OpenAI restructures into a public benefit corporation; Microsoft takes 27%
key_facts: Microsoft holds about 27 percent of OpenAI Group PBC, worth about $135bn.
OpenAI will buy $250bn of Microsoft Azure services.
The nonprofit OpenAI Foundation controls the PBC.
Starship launched from Starbase on the Texas Gulf Coast at 18:30 CDT.
All 33 Super Heavy booster engines ignited at launch.
The upper stage deployed eight dummy Starlink satellites.

cases.event: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai
key_facts: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
The prize was for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.
The winners share 12 million Swedish crowns (about $1.2 million).
